name: tui-live-preview
description: Preview .tui.cs views as real Terminal.Gui views, straight from the editor context menu.

tuiLivePreview.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `tuipreview` tool: a built `tuipreview.exe`, a `tuipreview.dll` (run with `dotnet`), or a `.csproj` (run with `dotnet run`). Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension. A workspace that contains the tool's source (`cli/bin/*/net*/tuipreview.exe` or `cli/TuiPreview.Cli.csproj`) uses that instead, so changes to the tool show up right away.

tuiLivePreview.className.markdownDescription: Override for the `--class` argument. When empty, the class comes from the view's own settings — a `// @tuipreview class=...` annotation or a `.tui.json` sidecar — and failing that from the namespace and class declaration of the `.tui.cs` itself. You are only prompted if none of those yield anything.

tuiLivePreview.width.description: Default render width in columns. Ignored in interactive mode, which fills the terminal, and overridden by a `width` in the view's own settings.

tuiLivePreview.height.description: Default render height in rows. Ignored in interactive mode, which fills the terminal, and overridden by a `height` in the view's own settings.

tuiLivePreview.ansi.description: Emit ANSI colour escapes in rendered output (sets TUI_ANSI=1).

tuiLivePreview.live.markdownDescription: Preview unsaved editor changes, not just what is on disk. The live buffer is mirrored to a scratch file that the preview watches, so edits appear without saving. Turn this off to always preview the last saved version, which is what you want when a rendered frame needs to be reproducible (CI, screenshots, a bug report).

tuiLivePreview.confirmation.description: Ask before starting a preview, so a mis-click cannot leave a watch process running.
